$comment: Price alerts (/alert). Fragment merged with en.json at load time; same key tree as fr/alerts.json.

alerts.created_already_met: ℹ️ The price already meets this condition: the alert will fire at the next market update ({when}).
alerts.created_footer: You will get a DM as soon as the market crosses this threshold.
alerts.list_empty: No active alert. Create one with `/alert create`.
alerts.list_footer: {count}/{max} alerts · market price, before quality and event bonuses

alerts.not_tracked: {item} is not tracked by the market: no alert can be set on it.
alerts.threshold_out_of_bounds: This threshold can never be reached: the price of {item} always stays between {min} and {max}.
alerts.too_many: You already have {active} active alerts (maximum {max}). Remove one with `/alert delete`.
alerts.not_found: Alert not found. Find its ID with `/alert list`.
alerts.ambiguous_id: Several alerts start with `{prefix}`: type more characters.

notifications.price_alert_above_body: {emoji} **{item}** rose to {price} 🪙, above your {threshold} 🪙 threshold. To sell: `/sell` or `/auction sell`.
notifications.price_alert_below_body: {emoji} **{item}** dropped to {price} 🪙, below your {threshold} 🪙 threshold. To buy on the auction house: `/auction list`.
